TSE news release (00:18 BRT 26 Oct) gives Lula 64,256,232 (51.79%) vs Flávio Bolsonaro 59,826,041 (48.21%); same figures in Gazeta do Povo and Rio Times; resultados.tse.jus.br itself was unreachable.
TSE: Lula 51.79% vs Flávio 48.21% of valid votes at 100%, a gap of 3.58 points, below 4.00.
TSE release gives Lula 51.79% of valid votes (64,256,232) at full totalisation; Gazeta do Povo has the same.
TSE release: abstention about 19.2% (128.2 million of over 158 million voters attended), i.e. turnout about 80.8%; Rio Times gives the TSE figure as 80.78% turnout / 19.22% abstention, above 79.41%.

Government programme had Babiš opening the Czech-Algerian business forum in Algiers at 11:00 on 26 Oct, and ČTK (story 2893063, 12:27 version datelined Alžír) and APS (12:58) report that the forum, the memoranda signed there and the Ghrieb talks went ahead as planned, so he was in Algeria before noon; vlada.gov.cz/aktualne, Babiš's X and the pre-noon ČTK versions could not be opened, and no report with a pre-noon timestamp saying he had landed was found.

ČTK (12:27 version) reports only that ČEZ CEO Beneš 'should negotiate' extending the gas deal and Havlíček saying volumes depend on the Algerian offer; Radio Prague (07:53, updated 12:05) quotes Havlíček that it was too early to say; nobody said a gas document had been or would be signed (vlada.gov.cz/aktualne unreachable).

Praha TV (26 Oct 17:09) reports the first joint STAN–Spolu–Praha sobě meeting ended with 'no coalition agreement yet' and talks continuing; ČT24 (22 Oct) had Praha sobě only wanting to continue talks; no statement by Praha sobě that it had agreed to join was found (ceskenoviny.cz homepage unreachable).

The Pirates rejected STAN's offer of one council seat on 22 Oct (also ČT24 that day); STAN then moved to three-party talks with Spolu and Praha sobě, and ČTK's preview of the 26 Oct talks mentions only an informal meeting with the Pirates; no Pirate acceptance before 12:00 on 26 Oct was found.

ČTK (published 26 Oct 17:58) reports the five groupings signed 'vpodvečer' (early evening) on 26 Oct, and Pardubický deník says 'v pondělních večerních hodinách', so no signing had been reported by 12:00.

ČTK first reported the Castle-confirmed number (51 honourees) on 27 Oct at 20:04, after the 26 Oct 12:00 deadline, and no earlier exact figure was found.
ČTK confirms that Majerová and Ševčík abstained on 22 Oct, but searches of ČTK and major Czech media found no sanction announced by SPD or its club against either of them by 26 Oct 12:00.

ods.cz and ČTK show only the 2024 club nomination and statements of intent (Nytra in Sep and on 20 Oct 2026 that the joint club will continue); no formal club or ODS decision nominating Vystrčil between 23 Oct and 26 Oct 12:00 was found.
